title: chant template
description: template.yml, version 1 of its contract: what a template asks for when someone requests an app or an add-on from it. It sits in the template's signed release beside the code it describes. A form shows one field per input; an agent and a command line read the same list. Each input has an engine-neutral kind, and each engine maps the kinds to its own types. Readers ignore fields they do not know; a field is only ever added within a version.

kind.description: What a request makes from this template: a new app, or an add-on to an app that already exists.

description.description: One or two sentences a person reads before requesting it.

inputs.description: The inputs, in the order a form shows them. Names are unique.

kind.description: An input's engine-neutral kind. string: a JSON string. number: a finite JSON number. bool: true or false. list: a JSON array, each element of kind `of` when given. map: a JSON object, each value of kind `of` when given. object: a JSON object with any fields. An engine maps each kind to one of its own types (Terraform: string, number, bool, list(<of>), map(<of>), and any for object or for a list or map without `of`).

name.description: The name a request gives the value under, and the variable the engine sets.

of.description: For a list or a map only: the kind of each element or value.

label.description: The form field's label. Absent: the name.

description.description: Help text shown under the field.

default.description: The value used when a request gives none. It must be of the input's kind. An input with a default is optional.

required.description: Whether a request must give a value. Absent: true when there is no default, false when there is. An input with a default cannot be required.

sensitive.description: A secret. A request never carries it, because the request is written into a pull request; the app reads it from its own secret store.
